name: Long Live The Rat Queen
source:
Long Live The Rat Queen is a short, very silly visual novel about helping a mouse assassinate the rat queen and take the throne! 

[Edited from [url=https://jellicube.itch.io/long-live-the-rat-queen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Long Live The Rat Queen》是一部短小又无厘头的视觉小说，讲述你帮助一只小鼠暗杀大鼠女王、夺取王位的故事！

[编译自[url=https://jellicube.itch.io/long-live-the-rat-queen]Itch.io[/url]]
